introWhat: Curated recipes (Lutris, community) and ProtonDB ratings for your library.
about: A fix is a recipe of winetricks packages and DLL overrides for one game. ProtonDB tiers run from Platinum (works out of the box) through Gold, Silver and Bronze to Borked (doesn't run).

empty.clearBody: No titles need attention. Switch to “{{allLabel}}” to browse ProtonDB tiers.
empty.noneBody: Compatibility data loads in the background after a scan. ProtonDB needs a network connection.

attention.borked: ProtonDB reports this title as borked. Try a different runner or check the reports.
attention.bronze: ProtonDB rates this title bronze. It may need tweaks to run well.
